name: Coupang

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Heavy - 2 DSA rounds, then a design round and a "focus" round, with a Bar Raiser gate similar to Amazon’s model
rounds: DSA round 2: a second algorithmic coding problem (candidates can be eliminated after these two rounds)
Design round: system design, scalability and trade-offs
Bar Raiser round: a final gate after the 4 main rounds, similar in spirit to Amazon’s Bar Raiser
extraTopics: Passing 2 back-to-back pure-DSA rounds before design is even discussed
A distinct "focus round" format not common at most companies - expect deep, role-specific questioning beyond generic DSA/design

sources.title: Glassdoor: Coupang Software Engineer interview reports (San Francisco and remote)
used: 4-round structure (2 DSA, 1 design, 1 focus) plus a Bar Raiser gate after round 4

rolesNotes: Only one source page was reviewed (aggregating a few independent reports). The Bar Raiser and "focus round" terminology mirror Amazon’s model closely, which may reflect hiring practices imported by ex-Amazon leadership at Coupang - worth confirming independently.
